Good to know

What can move the price

Extra prep work

Ground that needs more work to get level and ready before we pour adds time and crew.

Removing old surfaces

Ripping up and carting away an existing driveway, path or slab before the new pour. Starts from $20 per m².

Slope

A sloped or uneven block needs more forming and levelling to get a proper finish.

Ground conditions

Soft, rocky or reactive ground can need extra base prep to hold up over time.
